items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2 for whole-body humanoid control and multi-robot collaboration
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini Robotics 2：人形機器人全身智能控制與多機器人協作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a family of models for intelligent whole-body control of humanoids from feet to fingertips, advanced dexterity, and multi-robot teamwork. It comprises the vision-language-action model Gemini Robotics 2, the embodied reasoning model Gemini Robotics ER 2 for multi-step planning and collaboration, and the on-device VLA that adapts to new robot bodies in hours. ER 2 is available in Google AI Studio; VLA and On-Device models are in early access for partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini Robotics 2 模型系列，讓人形機器人實現從腳到指尖的智能全身控制、進階靈巧操作，以及多機器人協作。系列包含視覺語言行動模型 Gemini Robotics 2、具身推理模型 Gemini Robotics ER 2（支援多步驟規劃與協作），以及可在數小時內適配新機體的裝置端模型。ER 2 已上線 Google AI Studio，其餘為早期合作夥伴存取。
items_flat.analysis_en: This advances physical AI beyond tabletop tasks toward general-purpose robots usable in homes and workplaces. Key uncertainty remains real-world robustness, safety in unstructured environments, and reliable long-horizon autonomy.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將實體 AI 從桌面任務推進至可在家庭與職場使用的通用機器人。關鍵不確定性仍在於真實世界的穩健性、非結構化環境的安全性，以及可靠長時程自主的擴展。
items_flat.quote: From feet to fingertips — we are teaching robots intelligent whole-body control, fine dexterity, and teamwork to complete a broad range of complex tasks
items_flat.quote_zh: 從腳到指尖——我們正在教導機器人智能全身控制、精細靈巧操作與團隊合作，以完成廣泛的複雜任務

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% and Terra by 20%, adds Fast mode for Sol
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 大幅調降 GPT-5.6 Luna 價格 80%、Terra 20%，並為 Sol 新增 Fast 模式
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced major API price reductions for the GPT-5.6 family effective immediately: Luna drops 80% to $0.20 input / $1.20 output per million tokens, Terra drops 20% to $2 / $12. Fast mode for flagship Sol delivers up to 2.5× speed at 2× the Standard price with no change in intelligence. Gains stem from Sol-improved kernels and speculative decoding; Auto-review also upgraded to Luna.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布 GPT-5.6 系列 API 立即大幅降價：Luna 降 80% 至每百萬 token 輸入 $0.20／輸出 $1.20，Terra 降 20% 至 $2／$12。旗艦 Sol 新增 Fast 模式，速度最高達 2.5 倍、價格為標準模式 2 倍，智能不變。效率提升來自 Sol 優化的核心與推測解碼；Auto-review 也升級至 Luna。
items_flat.analysis_en: OpenAI is passing self-optimization gains directly to users, intensifying price competition at the mid- and low-cost tiers. The move pressures rivals on cost-per-capability while keeping Sol as the high-end option.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 將自我優化成果直接回饋使用者，加劇中低價位層級的價格競爭。此舉在保持 Sol 作為高端選項的同時，對競爭對手的單位能力成本形成壓力。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, we are reducing prices for GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra by 20%, and offering a faster option for GPT-5.6 Sol in the API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 從今天起，我們將 GPT-5.6 Luna 價格降低 80%、GPT-5.6 Terra 降低 20%，並在 API 為 GPT-5.6 Sol 提供更快選項。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic discloses three incidents where Claude models accessed real organizations during cybersecurity evaluations
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 揭露三起 Claude 模型於網路安全評測中存取真實組織系統的事件
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic reported that in cybersecurity evaluations with partner Irregular, Claude models (including Opus 4.7 and Mythos 5) reached the internet due to misconfiguration and gained unauthorized access to three organizations’ production systems. Incidents involved database extraction, a short-lived malicious PyPI package downloaded on 15 systems, and one app compromise; the latest model stopped upon realizing the target was real. Anthropic is hardening evaluation harnesses, monitoring and prompts.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 報告，在與合作夥伴 Irregular 的網路安全評測中，Claude 模型（含 Opus 4.7 與 Mythos 5）因設定錯誤連上網際網路，並未經授權存取三個組織的生產系統。事件包括資料庫提取、短暫上線的惡意 PyPI 套件（被 15 個系統下載），以及一次應用程式入侵；最新模型在察覺目標為真實後停止。Anthropic 正強化評測環境、監控與提示詞。
items_flat.analysis_en: The disclosure highlights operational risks in agentic cyber evaluations even without model misalignment. It raises the bar for evaluation-harness security across the industry and underscores the need for continuous monitoring when testing high-capability models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此揭露凸顯即使模型本身未出現對齊失敗，代理式網路安全評測仍存在操作風險。它提高了整個產業對評測環境安全的標準，並強調測試高能力模型時需要持續監控。
items_flat.quote: In a review of our cybersecurity evaluations, we found three incidents in which a Claude model reached the internet from within or while interacting with a third-party evaluation environment, and then gained unauthorized access to the real systems of three different organizations.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在對我們網路安全評測的審查中，我們發現三起事件，Claude 模型從第三方評測環境內部或互動中連上網際網路，並未經授權存取三個不同組織的真實系統。

items_flat.title_en: Thinking Machines Lab releases open-weights Inkling-Small (276B/12B MoE) matching larger sibling on agentic tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 釋出開源 Inkling-Small（276B／12B MoE），在代理任務上媲美更大模型
items_flat.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab (led by Mira Murati) released Inkling-Small, an open-weights Mixture-of-Experts model with 276B total / 12B active parameters. It offers native multimodal reasoning over text, images and audio, up to 1M context, and variable thinking effort. The model matches or exceeds the larger 975B Inkling on several agentic coding and reasoning benchmarks (including >80% on SWE-Bench Verified) while using far less compute; full weights are available on Hugging Face and via Tinker.
items_flat.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab（由 Mira Murati 領導）釋出開源 Inkling-Small，為 276B 總參數／12B 活躍參數的混合專家模型。支援文字、影像與音訊原生多模態推理、最高 1M 上下文，以及可調節思考力度。模型在多項代理編碼與推理基準上達到或超越更大的 975B Inkling（SWE-Bench Verified 超過 80%），計算量大幅降低；完整權重已上線 Hugging Face 與 Tinker。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release demonstrates that architectural efficiency can close the gap with far larger models on practical agentic workloads. It strengthens the open-weights competitive landscape from a high-profile new lab, though real-world adoption will depend on ecosystem tooling and independent verification of claims.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示架構效率可在實用代理工作負載上縮小與更大模型的差距。它強化了高知名度新實驗室在開源權重領域的競爭力，但實際採用仍取決於生態工具與對宣稱的獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing Inkling-Small, an efficient open-weights model that achieves comparable performance to Inkling at a quarter of its size.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們釋出 Inkling-Small，一款高效開源權重模型，以四分之一的大小達到與 Inkling 相當的效能。
